import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
ET.register_namespace('', NS)

def q(tag):
    return f'{{{NS}}}{tag}'

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
DST = 'sales_data.new.xlsx'

with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as z:
    entries = {n: z.read(n) for n in z.namelist()}

# ---- sheet1.xml ----
root = ET.fromstring(entries['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'])

dim = root.find(q('dimension'))
dim.set('ref', 'A1:H10')

cols = root.find(q('cols'))
col = ET.SubElement(cols, q('col'))
col.set('width', '12')
col.set('customWidth', '1')
col.set('min', '8')
col.set('max', '8')

sd = root.find(q('sheetData'))
rows = {r.get('r'): r for r in sd.findall(q('row'))}

def add_cell(row_el, ref, **attrs):
    c = ET.SubElement(row_el, q('c'))
    c.set('r', ref)
    for k, v in attrs.items():
        c.set(k, v)
    return c

c = add_cell(rows['1'], 'H1', s='1', t='inlineStr')
is_ = ET.SubElement(c, q('is'))
t = ET.SubElement(is_, q('t'))
t.text = 'Profit Margin %'

for r in range(2, 10):
    row = rows[str(r)]
    c = add_cell(row, f'H{r}', s='3')
    f = ET.SubElement(c, q('f'))
    f.text = f'IFERROR(G{r}/E{r},0)'
    ET.SubElement(c, q('v'))

c = add_cell(rows['10'], 'H10', s='3')
f = ET.SubElement(c, q('f'))
f.text = 'IFERROR(G10/E10,0)'
ET.SubElement(c, q('v'))

entries['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'] = ET.tostring(root, encoding='utf-8', xml_declaration=True)

# ---- styles.xml ----
st = ET.fromstring(entries['xl/styles.xml'])

numfmts = st.find(q('numFmts'))
numfmt = ET.SubElement(numfmts, q('numFmt'))
numfmt.set('numFmtId', '164')
numfmt.set('formatCode', '0.0%')
numfmts.set('count', '1')

cellxfs = st.find(q('cellXfs'))
xf = ET.SubElement(cellxfs, q('xf'))
xf.set('numFmtId', '164')
xf.set('fontId', '0')
xf.set('fillId', '0')
xf.set('borderId', '0')
xf.set('pivotButton', '0')
xf.set('quotePrefix', '0')
xf.set('xfId', '0')
cellxfs.set('count', '4')

entries['xl/styles.xml'] = ET.tostring(st, encoding='utf-8', xml_declaration=True)

with zipfile.ZipFile(DST, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    for name, data in entries.items():
        z.writestr(name, data)

print("wrote", DST)

import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
ET.register_namespace('', NS)

def q(tag):
    return f'{{{NS}}}{tag}'

SRC = 'sales_data.new.xlsx'
DST = 'sales_data.final.xlsx'

with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as z:
    entries = {n: z.read(n) for n in z.namelist()}

root = ET.fromstring(entries['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'])
sd = root.find(q('sheetData'))
rows = {r.get('r'): r for r in sd.findall(q('row'))}

def cell_val(row_el, col):
    for c in row_el.findall(q('c')):
        if c.get('r') == f'{col}{row_el.get("r")}':
            v = c.find(q('v'))
            return v.text if v is not None else None
    return None

def set_v(row_el, col, value):
    for c in row_el.findall(q('c')):
        if c.get('r') == f'{col}{row_el.get("r")}':
            v = c.find(q('v'))
            if v is None:
                v = ET.SubElement(c, q('v'))
            v.text = repr(value)
            return
    raise RuntimeError(f'cell {col}{row_el.get("r")} not found')

tot_rev = 0
tot_profit = 0
for r in range(2, 10):
    row = rows[str(r)]
    units = float(cell_val(row, 'C'))
    price = float(cell_val(row, 'D'))
    cost = float(cell_val(row, 'F'))
    rev = units * price
    profit = rev - units * cost
    tot_rev += rev
    tot_profit += profit
    set_v(row, 'H', profit / rev)

set_v(rows['10'], 'H', tot_profit / tot_rev)

entries['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'] = ET.tostring(root, encoding='utf-8', xml_declaration=True)

with zipfile.ZipFile(DST, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    for name, data in entries.items():
        z.writestr(name, data)

print(f'total revenue={tot_rev}, total profit={tot_profit}, overall margin={tot_profit/tot_rev:.6f}')
print('wrote', DST)
